newsitem.title: UK: UK'S FTSE 100 POWERS AHEAD AFTER RATE RISE.
newsitem.headline: UK'S FTSE 100 POWERS AHEAD AFTER RATE RISE.

text.p: The FTSE 100 powered to fresh high in a second burst after the Bank of England raised rates and indicated that this would be the last hike in the current cycle.
The index traded 59 points up at 5,085.2 by 1244 GMT with volume at 653.6 million shares and the September futures contract at 5,117, up 68 points.
The FTSE was slightly lower ahead of the rate rise news.
